name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Read-only route diagnostics for the existing bidirectional tram stop prototype.
description: Revision 12 changes only diagnostics and documentation. The revision-11 stops place successfully and their segment networks report forwardOnly=false and needsReservation=true, but the complete link via ordinary tramtrack still has a TRAM/ELECTRIC_TRAM path only in one direction. Extended read-only probes compare local station spans with complete terminal routes for TRAM, ELECTRIC_TRAM, both railtram modes and combined tram/railtram mode sets. The saved setup does not need rebuilding. Replace the files, reload the existing test save and run ten seconds. No station, profile, vehicle, line or world commands are changed. This update does not repair the route or prove vehicle reversal.
